metadata.description: Comprehensive CPFD model of a municipal drinking water treatment facility with five-stage treatment process (intake, coagulation/flocculation, sedimentation, filtration, disinfection) and SCADA control system

elements.name: Onsite Human Plant Operator(s)
elements.description: Human operators physically present at the treatment facility who monitor processes, respond to alarms, perform maintenance, and execute control actions via HMI terminals and manual interventions

elements.name: Offsite Human Plant Operator(s)
elements.description: Remote operators who monitor and control facility operations via SCADA system over Internet/VPN connections, typically for after-hours monitoring or emergency response

elements.name: Electric Utility Provider
elements.description: External power utility providing electrical energy to the facility; single-point-of-failure for all cyber-physical systems requiring electricity

elements.name: Water Source
elements.description: Natural water source (river, lake, reservoir, or aquifer) providing raw water input to the treatment facility; quality and availability subject to environmental conditions

elements.name: Water Distribution Network
elements.description: Municipal water distribution infrastructure delivering treated water to consumers; includes pipes, pumps, storage towers, and pressure regulation systems

elements.name: Landfill
elements.description: Waste disposal site receiving sludge, sediment, and filter residue removed during treatment processes

elements.name: Org Intranet
elements.description: Internal organizational network providing connectivity for administrative functions, data reporting, and potential attack vector if not properly segmented from SCADA network

elements.name: Internet
elements.description: Public Internet providing remote access capability; primary external cyber threat vector requiring robust firewall protection and access controls

elements.name: Drinking Water Treatment Facility
elements.description: Primary facility perimeter providing physical barriers (fences, gates, walls) and cyber controls (access authentication, surveillance monitoring); encloses all treatment processes and control systems

elements.name: Post-treatment shed
elements.description: Locked physical enclosure housing post-treatment chemical dosing equipment; controls access to CPD11, CPD12, PS4; nested within CPTB1

elements.name: Electrical shed
elements.description: Locked physical enclosure housing main power distribution panel; controls access to CPD13; critical single-point-of-failure; nested within CPTB1

elements.name: Intake
elements.description: Automated intake process drawing raw water from source; monitors level, flow, turbidity, temperature, conductivity, pH via RTU sensors; controls gates, screens, pumps via PLC actuators

elements.name: Coagulation / Flocculation
elements.description: Chemical treatment process where coagulants destabilize suspended particles followed by gentle mixing to form larger flocs; monitors pH, turbidity, streaming current via RTU sensors; controls mixers, dosing pumps, valves via PLC actuators

elements.name: Sedimentation
elements.description: Gravity-driven settling process where flocs sink to form sludge blanket; monitors sludge blanket level, turbidity, flow via RTU sensors; controls clarifiers, sludge scrapers, tube settlers via PLC actuators

elements.name: Filtration
elements.description: Multi-layer media filtration removing remaining particulates and microorganisms; monitors turbidity, differential pressure, flow, particle count via RTU sensors; controls filters, media, backwash cycles via PLC actuators

elements.name: Disinfection
elements.description: Chemical disinfection (chlorine, chloramines) and/or UV treatment to inactivate remaining pathogens; monitors chlorine, ORP, UV intensity, pH, flow via RTU sensors; controls feed pumps, UV lamps, dosing valves via PLC actuators

elements.name: Chemical Posttreatment
elements.description: Final chemical adjustment (pH, corrosion inhibitors, fluoride) for water quality compliance and distribution system protection; monitors via RTU sensors; controls feed pumps and dosing valves via PLC actuators

elements.name: Waste collection and disposal
elements.description: Collection and consolidation of treatment process wastes (sludge, sediment, filter backwash residue) for disposal or potential resource recovery

elements.name: Coagulant / Flocculant
elements.description: Chemical storage for coagulation agents (aluminum sulfate, ferric chloride, polymers); typically stored in bulk tanks with containment; subject to supply chain vulnerabilities and contamination risks

elements.name: Sediment
elements.description: Accumulated sludge and sediment removed during sedimentation process; stored temporarily before waste disposal; represents potential environmental hazard if improperly managed

elements.name: Chemical Disinfectant
elements.description: Primary disinfectant storage (liquid chlorine, sodium hypochlorite, chlorine gas); highly hazardous material requiring special handling; attractive target for theft or sabotage given public health consequences

elements.name: Post Chemical
elements.description: Post-treatment chemical storage (pH adjusters, corrosion inhibitors, fluoride compounds); required for final water quality adjustment and distribution system protection

elements.name: Water Storage
elements.description: Finished water storage providing operational buffering and emergency reserve; typically large tanks or reservoirs; vulnerable to contamination if access controls fail

elements.name: RTU Sensors (Level, flow, turbidity, temp, conductivity, pH)
elements.description: Remote Terminal Unit with sensors monitoring intake water quality and quantity; transmits telemetry data to SCADA; vulnerable to sensor spoofing, signal interception, and physical tampering

elements.name: PLC Actuators (gates, screens, pumps)
elements.description: Programmable Logic Controller managing intake actuators; receives control signals from SCADA; executes local control logic; vulnerable to logic manipulation, unauthorized commands, and network attacks

elements.name: PLC Actuators (mixers, dosing pumps, valves)
elements.description: PLC controlling coagulation/flocculation equipment and chemical dosing; critical for proper treatment chemistry; vulnerable to dosing manipulation attacks with public health consequences

elements.name: RTU Sensors (pH, turbidity, streaming current)
elements.description: RTU monitoring coagulation/flocculation effectiveness; streaming current sensor provides real-time dosing feedback; vulnerable to sensor spoofing potentially causing under/over-dosing

elements.name: RTU Sensors (Sludge blanket, turbidity, flow)
elements.description: RTU monitoring sedimentation basin performance; sludge blanket level critical for maintaining settling efficiency; vulnerable to sensor failures causing clarified water quality degradation

elements.name: PLC Actuators (clarifiers, sludge scrapers, tube settlers)
elements.description: PLC managing sedimentation mechanical equipment; controls sludge removal timing; vulnerable to manipulation causing basin overflow or incomplete settling

elements.name: RTU Sensors (Turbidity, ΔP, flow, particle)
elements.description: RTU monitoring filter performance; differential pressure indicates filter clogging; turbidity monitors breakthrough; particle counters detect treatment failures; critical for EPA compliance

elements.name: PLC Actuators (filters, media, backwash)
elements.description: PLC controlling filtration operations and automated backwash cycles; improper backwash timing risks filter bed disruption or media loss; vulnerable to denial-of-service via excessive backwashing

elements.name: RTU Sensors (Chlorine, ORP, UV, pH, flow)
elements.description: RTU monitoring disinfection effectiveness; chlorine residual and ORP (oxidation-reduction potential) indicate disinfection status; UV sensors verify lamp intensity; critical for pathogen inactivation

elements.name: PLC Actuators (Feed pumps, UV lamps, dosing valves)
elements.description: PLC controlling disinfection equipment; manages chlorine dosing and UV lamp operation; most critical control point for public health protection; vulnerable to under-dosing attacks causing disease outbreaks

elements.name: PLC Actuators (Feed pumps, dosing valves)
elements.description: PLC controlling post-treatment chemical dosing within secured shed (PTB1); manages pH adjustment and corrosion inhibition; physical access controls complement cyber defenses

elements.name: RTU Sensors
elements.description: RTU monitoring post-treatment water quality within secured shed (PTB1); verifies final compliance with drinking water standards before distribution

elements.name: Main Power Distribution Panel
elements.description: Electrical distribution system within secured shed (PTB2); provides power to all cyber-physical devices; single-point-of-failure; vulnerable to physical sabotage causing complete facility shutdown

elements.name: SCADA Computer / HMI
elements.description: Human-Machine Interface providing operator visibility and control; aggregates telemetry from all RTUs; sends commands to all PLCs; central target for cyber intrusion; often runs on legacy operating systems with limited security

elements.name: Internet Link / Firewall
elements.description: Network security device mediating external connectivity; provides VPN access for remote operators; critical cyber perimeter defense; configuration errors enable unauthorized access; may be bypassed by UAV-deployed network taps

elements.name: Coagulation / Flocculation Tank
elements.description: Enclosed physical tank for chemical treatment; not accessible to UAV-dropped contaminants; vulnerable to structural damage from explosives or prolonged chemical exposure; contains aggressive mixing equipment

elements.name: Sedimentation Tank
elements.description: Large settling basin for gravity separation; may be open or covered; open basins vulnerable to UAV-delivered contaminants and reconnaissance; contains settled sludge requiring periodic removal

elements.name: Filtration Tank
elements.description: Enclosed pressure vessel or gravity filter containing multi-layer media (sand, anthracite, garnet); not accessible to UAV attacks; vulnerable to media contamination during maintenance; requires periodic backwashing

elements.name: Disinfection Tank
elements.description: Contact chamber providing residence time for disinfectant action; may be enclosed tank or open channel; open configurations vulnerable to UAV contamination; structural damage risks disinfection bypass

elements.name: Storage Pump
elements.description: High-capacity pump moving treated water to distribution; critical for maintaining system pressure; mechanical failure or sabotage causes service disruption; vulnerable to physical and cyber-enabled attacks

elements.name: Source Water
elements.description: Raw water flowing from natural source to intake structure via submerged pipe; vulnerable to UUV-delivered contaminants injected directly into flow; quality subject to upstream pollution and environmental conditions

elements.name: Source Water
elements.description: Raw water processed through intake screens and pumped to coagulation/flocculation tanks; brief exposure during open-channel flow represents UAV contamination window if intake is not fully enclosed

elements.name: Chemical
elements.description: Coagulant/flocculant chemicals dosed into treatment process; precise dosing critical for effectiveness; vulnerable to supply chain contamination, storage tank breaches, and dosing system manipulation

elements.name: Flocculated Water
elements.description: Water with formed flocs flowing from coagulation/flocculation to sedimentation; floc integrity critical for settling; excessive turbulence or chemical imbalance disrupts treatment effectiveness

elements.name: Telemetry & Control
elements.description: Bi-directional communication between onsite operators and SCADA HMI; includes alarm acknowledgments, setpoint changes, and manual control actions; vulnerable to insider threats and shoulder-surfing attacks

elements.name: Remote Telemetry & Control
elements.description: SCADA telemetry data transmitted to offsite operators for monitoring; provides situational awareness for remote response; vulnerable to interception revealing facility operational state

elements.name: Remote Telemetry & Control
elements.description: Control commands from offsite operators to SCADA system via Internet/VPN; enables remote emergency response; primary external cyber attack vector; requires strong authentication and encryption

elements.name: Telemetry
elements.description: Sensor data from intake RTU to SCADA; includes level, flow, turbidity, temperature, conductivity, pH measurements; vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks, sensor spoofing, and RF interception by UAV-deployed equipment

elements.name: Telemetry
elements.description: Sensor data from coagulation/flocculation RTU to SCADA; pH, turbidity, streaming current critical for dosing control; spoofed readings could cause chemical over/under-dosing with cascading treatment failures

elements.name: Electricity
elements.description: Electrical power from utility provider to main distribution panel within electrical shed (PTB2); powers all cyber-physical devices; single-point-of-failure; loss causes complete facility shutdown; vulnerable to grid attacks and physical sabotage

elements.name: SCADA
elements.description: SCADA HMI display and control interface accessed by onsite operators; aggregates all telemetry and enables control actions; vulnerable to HMI manipulation, display spoofing, and malicious operator actions

elements.name: Source Water Intake Pipe
elements.description: Submerged pipeline connecting water source to intake structure; typically concrete or steel; vulnerable to UUV kinetic attacks, underwater sensor deployment, and direct contaminant injection; difficult to inspect and defend

elements.name: Source Water Transport Pipe
elements.description: Pipeline transporting raw water from intake to coagulation/flocculation tanks; pressurized flow; vulnerable to physical breaches causing water loss and contamination ingress

elements.name: Flocculated Water Pipe
elements.description: Pipeline carrying flocculated water from coagulation/flocculation to sedimentation; typically larger diameter to accommodate floc without shearing; vulnerable to structural damage disrupting treatment continuity
